## Changes

- Replace periodic cloud uploads with event-driven sync, batched playback progress and pause/exit flushes. Preserve local data when devices have conflicting changes.
- Improve focus visibility across account forms, profile setup, Account settings, addon actions and details dialogs using shared button styling.
- Keep focus in the settings sidebar when selecting Account.
- Fix remote navigation to App Diagnostics Refresh, Export and Clear actions.
- Default basic and detailed logging to off while retaining crashes, exceptions and available abnormal-exit evidence.
- Expand app diagnostics beyond playback to authentication, updates, lifecycle, search, sync and pairing, with bounded local storage and credential redaction.

## Verification

164 local JVM tests passed, including signature verification against the signed APK. Release lint reported no errors; Android instrumentation sources compiled. Physical Fire TV focus/visual validation and live two-device sync testing remain pending. The earlier immediate updater crash is not claimed to be confirmed fixed.

Signed 32-bit armeabi-v7a build for Android 8.0 and newer, using the existing Saab TV release key. Install over the previous version without uninstalling.
